content_variants.text:
Sources from the occupied Afrin Canton told ANHA reporter that 25 injuries, including women and children, occurred in the neighborhoods of Mahmudiya and Ashrafie in the occupied Afrin district, as a result of heavy indiscriminate firing by the mercenaries of the Turkish occupation, in celebration of Erdogan's win of the Turkey presidency for another 5 years.

Yesterday, other sources reported to ANHA correspondent that a child was killed by mercenary bullets in the Mahmudiya neighborhood in occupied Afrin, to celebrate Erdogan's win over his rival Kemal Kilijdaroghlo in the Turkish presidential elections.

The other occupied areas also witnessed heavy and indiscriminate gunfire for the same reason, which led to injuries, as the Syrian Observatory reported that 2 people were injured near Al-Thura bakery, and a woman in Sajo camp, in the occupied Azaz.

And also reported the injury of some people in the occupied city of Sere Kaniye.

The heavy shooting of the Turkish occupation mercenaries made discontent and panic among the people.

Sh-S

ANHA
